name: publisher_crash__odometry
regression: Publisher loss, told apart from stale telemetry (publisher still advertised) and from transport loss (the whole host silent): the flight recorder's node_disappeared trigger names the node, and the silent topic is attributed to it.
initial_conditions: No fault. Baseline for false positives.
injected_fault: The odometry publisher node /utlidar_node leaves the ROS graph at t=3.0 s and its topic stops; lowstate from the same host keeps arriving.
